items.label: Standard Density Lumbar Support Pillow
items.value: Measures approximately 11” long x 4.75” diameter. Offers moderate support. Also available in Firm Density.

items.label: Top-Selling Back Pillow
items.value: The top lumbar pillow for back pain relief and lower back support; recommended by back pain professionals, physical therapists and chiropractors around the world.

items.label: Versatile and easy to carry
items.value: Use as a lumbar support pillow for office chair back support or car back support cushion. Light enough to use as a travel lumbar support.

items.label: Back Support
items.value: This back support pillow helps provide lumbar (low back) pain relief by ensuring proper spine alignment and posture while sitting.

items.label: High-Quality
items.value: This lumbar back pillow is made from long-lasting foam with moisture-wicking, 100% polyester removable cover. The 1.5" elastic strap can be worn around the waist or adjusted as a back pillow for chair backs. Made in the USA.

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Adjustable Elastic Strap, Breathable, Lightweight, Removable Cover, Wicking
